title: krn lane start refuses non-delivery lanes above the ceiling
body:
Outcome: krn lane start for a non-delivery task exits non-zero while krn ledger --check-ceiling is over 30%. Why: the ceiling is one line of skill text (.agents/skills/krn-lead/SKILL.md:35-36); non-delivery spend reached 75%. Proof: a lane start test with a ledger fixture above the ceiling. Scope: src/cli/lane.ts, src/outcome ledger reader, tests.
Evidence: .krn/runs/qwen-research/report.md (Qwen 4 audit) verified by krn-reader against HEAD 8152cee.
